resend:index:ApiKey.description: A Resend API key. The `token` output is only available from the Resend API at creation time; it cannot be recovered later.

domainId.description: Restrict a `sending_access` key to a single domain.

name.description: The API key name. Maximum 50 characters.

token.description: The API key credential. Only returned by Resend at creation time; empty after import.

resend:index:ContactProperty.description: A Resend custom contact property definition.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when Resend created the contact property, as returned by the Resend API `created_at` string.

fallbackValue.description: Optional fallback value used when a contact does not have this property set. Values must match `type` (`string` or `number`). Fallback changes, including clearing a previously non-null fallback, update in place.

key.description: The contact property key. Resend allows up to 50 alphanumeric or underscore characters. The key cannot be changed after creation, so changes replace the resource.

type.description: The contact property type, either `string` or `number`. The type cannot be changed after creation, so changes replace the resource.

type.description: The contact property type, either `string` or `number`. The type cannot be changed after creation, so changes replace the resource.

resend:index:Domain.description: A domain registered with Resend for sending (and optionally receiving) email. The `records` output contains the DNS records that must be created before the domain can be verified.

clickTracking.description: Track link clicks in HTML emails. Requires a verified tracking subdomain.

customReturnPath.description: The subdomain used for the Return-Path address. Defaults to `send`.

openTracking.description: Track email open rates. Requires a verified tracking subdomain.

records.description: The DNS records to create for this domain.

region.description: The region emails are sent from: `us-east-1` (default), `eu-west-1`, `sa-east-1`, or `ap-northeast-1`.

status.description: The verification status of the domain.

trackingSubdomain.description: Custom subdomain used for open/click tracking links.

resend:index:DomainVerification.description: Triggers verification of a Resend domain and waits until the domain's DNS records have been verified. Create this resource after the domain's DNS records (from the `Domain` resource's `records` output) have been published.

domainId.description: The ID of the domain to verify.

status.description: The verification status of the domain.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for verification before failing. Defaults to 900 seconds.

domainId.description: The ID of the domain to verify.

resend:index:Segment.description: A Resend segment for grouping contacts.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when Resend created the segment, as returned by the Resend API `created_at` string in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm+00` format (for example, `2026-10-06 22:59:55.977+00`).

resend:index:Topic.description: A Resend broadcast topic used to manage contact subscription preferences.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when Resend created the topic, as returned by the Resend API `created_at` string in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff+00` format (for example, `2023-04-08 00:11:13.110779+00`).

defaultSubscription.description: The default subscription preference for new contacts, either `opt_in` or `opt_out`. Resend does not allow this value to change after creation, so changes replace the topic.

description.description: An optional topic description. Non-empty values are sent to Resend on create and update. Because resend-go v4.2.0 omits empty `description` values from update requests, clearing an existing description replaces the topic.

description.description: An optional topic description. Non-empty values are sent to Resend on create and update. Because resend-go v4.2.0 omits empty `description` values from update requests, clearing an existing description replaces the topic.

resend:index:Webhook.description: A Resend webhook that delivers events to an HTTPS endpoint. If Resend omits the `signingSecret` during import or read, the provider returns an empty secret for imports and preserves any existing state value during refreshes.

endpoint.description: The HTTPS URL events are delivered to.

events.description: The event types to subscribe to, e.g. `email.sent` or `domain.updated`.

signingSecret.description: The secret used to verify webhook payload signatures; may be empty after import if Resend does not return it.

endpoint.description: The HTTPS URL events are delivered to.

events.description: The event types to subscribe to, e.g. `email.sent` or `domain.updated`.
